prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single exquisite TOP LEFT corner ornament for a fantasy guild's parchment letter, isolated on genuinely transparent background. Square canvas. No paper, no background, no rectangular plate, no drop shadow, no text, no full frame, no other corners. One top-left ornamental corner only.
